A human accommodation. Getting back to the home page means finding the nav line under the header, which differs by page, or editing the URL. The header's links are in the same place on every page.

Decision: Every header's links start with "home"

where src/render.ts file page

quote <span class="links"><a rel="help" href="${rel(here, 'guide/')}">guide</a>

Because (Jeff): a person wants one place to go home from, wherever they are. It's first, so the links read home, guide, profile; the dev server's draft link comes after home, so it reads home, draft, guide, profile.

Decision: The draft link goes after home
